description: Header file defining classes and templates for thread worker pools and task queues with multiple priority support in the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: base_worker_pool
classes.description: Manages a pool of worker threads with no task enqueueing policy.

classes.name: base_priority_task_queue
classes.description: Base class managing a priority task queue.

classes.name: base_task_queue<concurrent_queue_policy>
classes.description: Template specializations for different queue policies managing task queues.

classes.name: priority_task_worker_pool
classes.description: Pool supporting multiple priority levels for dispatched tasks.

classes.name: task_worker_pool<QueuePolicy>
classes.description: Template class for a simple task worker pool sharing a queue among workers.

classes.name: task_worker_pool_executor<QueuePolicy>
classes.description: Executor wrapping a task worker pool for task execution.

classes.name: priority_task_worker_pool_executor
classes.description: Executor for pushing tasks with priority to a priority worker pool.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the worker pool.

methods.name: nof_workers
methods.description: Returns the number of worker threads.

methods.name: is_in_thread_pool
methods.description: Checks if the caller is inside the thread pool.

methods.name: push_task
methods.description: Enqueues a task with a specified priority into the priority task queue.

methods.name: push_task_blocking
methods.description: Enqueues a task with a specified priority, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: nof_pending_tasks
methods.description: Returns the number of enqueued tasks.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the capacity for a given priority.

methods.name: wait_pending_tasks
methods.description: Waits until all enqueued tasks are completed.

methods.name: push_task
methods.description: Enqueues a task into the worker pool, skipping if full.

methods.name: push_task_blocking
methods.description: Enqueues a task into the worker pool, blocking if full.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a task, possibly inline if conditions permit.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Defers a task to be executed later.

methods.name: can_run_task_inline
methods.description: Checks if a task can be run inline in the current thread.
